UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated learner profile and practice preferences stored per user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Learner display name shown in greetings and profile.

demoSeed.description: Whether first collect-request run uses deterministic demo seed.

checklist.description: Completed emergency preparedness checklist item IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

DrillAttempt.title: DrillAttempt
DrillAttempt.description: A completed timed drill run, grading breakdown, and optional follow-up quiz.

id.description: Unique attempt identifier matching the document ID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who completed this attempt.

concept.description: Primary fraud safety concept trained by this drill.

seed.description: Deterministic randomisation seed used for this run.

demoSeed.description: Whether this attempt used the demo seed.

timerMode.description: Timer mode active during the drill.

startedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds when drill started.

finishedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds when drill finished.

grade.description: Structured grading scores, flags, timing, and step results.

quiz.description: Optional follow-up quiz answers attached after drill completion.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was last updated.

AnalyticsEventRecord.title: AnalyticsEventRecord
AnalyticsEventRecord.description: Granular drill interaction telemetry event owned by the learner.

id.description: Unique event identifier matching the document ID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner.

ts.description: Client epoch milliseconds of the event.

stepId.description: Optional step ID within the drill.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was stored.

LiveAlertCase.title: LiveAlertCase
LiveAlertCase.description: Weekly refreshed real-life fraud case study added to the live scam alerts strip and fraud library.

id.description: Unique alert case identifier matching the document ID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who synced this weekly alert.

location.description: City or state where the reported incident occurred.

summary.description: Concise summary of the real-life case study.

howItWorks.description: Chronological steps explaining how the scam worked.

redFlags.description: Warning signs present in the incident.

source.description: Cited news or official advisory source metadata.

verified.description: Whether a grounded source URL is attached.

lastVerifiedOn.description: Date or month string of the source verification.

weekKey.description: ISO week key for weekly refresh tracking (e.g. 2026-W47).

refreshedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds when the weekly batch was fetched.

isLiveAlert.description: Marks the library entry as a weekly refreshed live alert case study.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private learner profile, timer preference, demo seed flag, checklist items, and bookmarks.

/users/{userId}/attempts/{attemptId}.description: Learner drill attempt history and optional attached quiz responses.

/users/{userId}/events/{eventId}.description: Learner drill step/flag interaction events used for Readiness statistics.

/users/{userId}/alerts/{alertId}.description: Weekly refreshed real-life scam case studies synced per learner for alerts and library.
